{{Quote|Oh, gooba fish!|[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Gooberfish''', also known as a '''gooba''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] native to to the oceans of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. A [[Lake Vis|lake]] near [[Vis/Legends|Vis]] was rich in this kind of fish. When an [[Opee sea killer/Legends|opee sea killer]] attacked the [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|bongo]] piloted by [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] after viewing it as food, [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] referred to it as a "big gooberfish."<ref name="TPM" />
